verdict.rationale: Relay's evidence shows only US account and routing numbers (relay-docs-7, relay-docs-32) and the ability to activate receiving international wires (relay-docs-23). Receiving international wires is an adjacent capability, not local account details in multiple currencies. Nothing in the pack documents non-USD balances or foreign local account details such as an IBAN or sort code, though the axis is a fair question for a business banking platform.
